title: Gloucester Somersault
statementMd:
A piece of cheese with polygonal cross-sectional area is rolling along a flat surface as part of a major sporting event.

The piece of cheese rotates clockwise continuously, pivoting around the vertex with lowest $y$-coordinate and, in case of a tie, greatest x-coordinate.

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/861fb22ce490440238d75d5e0de65947dcbb5fd7.png)Illustration of Sample Input 1.

The finish line is $m$ metres from the origin point and must be crossed at ground level, meaning that one of the vertices on the ground is strictly past the line.

How many revolutions does the piece of cheese make in order for at least one part touching the ground to be strictly past the line?

## Input

- The first line of input contains the number of vertices of the cheese piece, $n$ ($3 \le n \le 10\,000$), and the integer $x$-coordinate of the finish line in metres, $m$ ($1 \le m \le 10^6$).
- The next $n$ lines of input contain the $x$ and $y$ coordinates of cheese vertices, in anti-clockwise order, $x_i$ and $y_i$ ($0 \le x_i, y_i \le 10\,000$).

No three adjacent vertices on the shape are collinear and at least one vertex has $y = 0$. The cheese has not yet crossed the line.

## Output

Output the number of full $360$-degree rotations performed by the piece of cheese until it strictly crosses the line on the ground, rounded up to an integer.
statementZhMd:
在一项大型体育赛事中，一块横截面为多边形的奶酪正在平坦的地面上滚动。

奶酪持续沿顺时针方向旋转，每次都以 y𝑦 坐标最小的顶点为支点；若有多个这样的顶点，则选择其中 x 坐标最大的顶点。

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/861fb22ce490440238d75d5e0de65947dcbb5fd7.png)样例输入 1 的示意图。

终点线距离原点 m𝑚 米，且奶酪必须在地面处越过终点线，也就是说，必须有一个接触地面的顶点严格越过终点线。

奶酪需要旋转多少圈，才能使至少一个接触地面的部分严格越过终点线？

## 输入格式

- 输入的第一行包含奶酪的顶点数 n𝑛 (3≤n≤100003≤𝑛≤10000)，以及终点线以米为单位的整数 x𝑥 坐标 m𝑚 (1≤m≤1061≤𝑚≤106)。
- 接下来 n𝑛 行按逆时针顺序给出奶酪各顶点的 x𝑥 和 y𝑦 坐标，即 xi𝑥𝑖 和 yi𝑦𝑖 (0≤xi,yi≤100000≤𝑥𝑖,𝑦𝑖≤10000)。

该多边形中任意三个相邻顶点均不共线，且至少有一个顶点满足 y=0𝑦=0。奶酪尚未越过终点线。

## 输出格式

输出奶酪在地面处严格越过终点线所需的旋转圈数，每圈为 360360 度，结果向上取整。
